posts.description: It’s 7am, it’s darker than it should be for this hour in early June, it’s raining, and the temperature hasn’t reached 16°C yet. posts.title: A World Cup Like No Other
posts.description: The first World Cup that I watched with any real interest was the 1970 tournament in Mexico, which was relatively untainted by controversy, except of course the Bobby Moore bracelet incident. The England captain was accused of stealing the jewellery from a hotel shop in Bogotá, Colombia, just before the World Cup in what was believed to be a frame-up to disrupt the team.
